about_the_game:
Dungeon Inspection Guild is a dungeon builder game inspired by classic action-adventure games, where the you take on the role of inspecting dungeons to ensure they are working and up to code! Play as the Inspector fixing and customizing dungeons to fit the requirements of the D.I.G. and the whims of the dungeon masters; build your own dungeons to share with others; or simply go on a questing spree playing the community's dungeons!

Features

  • Choose from a selection of room templates to start building the dungeon of your dreams!

  • Multi-room dungeons: expand the number of rooms needed to make your dungeon feel expansive.

  • A plethora of helpful and hazardous objects are available to customize the dungeon to any level of creativity or difficulty.

  • Discover novel interactions when certain objects intersect, such as slimes turning into blast slimes when subjected to fire!

  • Import and export player-generated dungeons!

Campaign Mode

Take on assignments from the D.I.G., where you will be given a list of requirements from a mix of D.I.G. standards and the preferences of the dungeon owner. Make sure you follow the list and are within budget.

Creative Mode

Design your own dungeon from scratch. We have a multitude of assets to cater to your dream dungeon. With this simple level editor you can create a multi-room dungeon, each room with their own gimmick.

Community Mode

Share your dungeon with friends or explore other user-submitted dungeons. Perhaps you'd like to challenge others by creating a difficult gauntlet of a dungeon or be the one to take on the challenge yourself.

But above all else, remember:

"Just because you couldn't make it as an Adventurer, doesn't mean you can't make adventures!"

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mojave 10.14+
  • Processor: Apple Silicon, x64 architecture with SSE2.
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal capable Intel and AMD GPUs
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+), Windows 10 and Windows 11
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, ARM64.
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

short_description: Dungeon Inspection Guild is a top-down dungeon editor inspired by classic Action-Adventure games. Bring broken dungeons up to code while catering to the whims of the dungeon owners. Create and customize your own dungeons; share them with others; or explore other dungeons from the community!
